# Security policy

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](SECURITY.vi.md)

Please report suspected vulnerabilities privately to **i.am@dangkhoa.dev** rather than posting credentials or exploit details in a public issue.

Read the full [security and responsible disclosure policy](../SECURITY.md) for safe log sharing, token handling, loopback-only API use and the limitations of experimental TPU serving.
